exposure: blood loss before balloon insertion (<1000 mL vs. >2000 mL for vaginal deliveries)
outcome: success rate of Bakri balloon tamponade
cohort: 407 women with postpartum bleeding who failed to respond to first-line conservative management and received a Bakri balloon in South China
finding: The Bakri balloon tamponade had a 91.65% success rate in controlling postpartum hemorrhage.
mod_finding: During vaginal deliveries, women with hemorrhage >2000 mL before balloon insertion had significantly more blood loss and lower maternal hemoglobin after using the Bakri balloon compared to those with hemorrhage <1000 mL; similar findings were observed for cesarean deliveries.
